items.title: BBC Three, BBC Scotland and Radio 4 Extra broadcast channels to close
items.summary: The closurse are announced as the corporation continues to try to save £500m over two years.

items.title: North Korea publishes photos of Kim Jong Un - why do rumours of his death keep coming back?
items.summary: North Korean state media has published photos of the dictator with his daughter after the unsubstantiated rumour spread.

items.title: UK to deploy jets to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks
items.summary: The UK announces it will provide additional defensive military support to Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate in the region.

items.title: Student who stabbed housemate 30 times admits murder
items.summary: Zack Coughlan changes his plea and admits murdering Jamie Collins (pictured) near their Bristol home.

items.title: Huge setback for Alberta's separatist movement after decisive defeat
items.summary: Leaders of the movement for independence vow to push on but the margin of defeat could make that difficult.

items.title: Man charged with attack on Australian MP as suspect's father says she is family friend
items.summary: Brendan Nugent's family say they have known Helen Haines, who remains in a critical condition, for more than 20 years.

items.title: Woman describes alleged assault by Russell Brand as 'frenzied' and 'violent'
items.summary: The entertainer denies three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

items.title: Harry says he wants to 'reconcile' with his family
items.summary: Prince Harry says he wants reconciliation with his family, in an interview with a magazine in New York last month.
